how_to_score: Each article is the list of boxes under it. Those boxes are one story and must be merged. A box from one article must not be merged into another. The order of the boxes is the reading order. Compare regions, not OCR text. The print is faint. An engine that returns only the headlines has not read the page, and it can still be scored on these boxes.
